actionability.cwe_name: OS command injection via controlled argv/cmdline
actionability.explanation: While processing a crafted input, the program hit a fault in the affected code and stopped. At minimum this lets an attacker who can supply this input crash the program; the underlying defect should be reviewed. Triggered by the attached test input (`testcase.bin`).

patch_hints.guidance: Pass an argv array or a validated enum command instead of building a shell string from input bytes.
patch_hints.title: Avoid shell command strings
